probes.question: What is the longest an American crow is known to have lived in captivity?
True or false: crows can recognise individual human faces.

image.alt: A black crow standing on a white ledge, looking to the left.

body.question: Crows can recognise individual people. What is the longest an American crow is known to have lived in captivity?
body.reveal: Captive American crows are known to have lived up to 30 years, while the average in the wild is 7 to 8. Plenty of time to remember a face: studies indicate crows remember dangerous human faces and can pass that on to other crows.
